source_note: D-3e re-derivation: every mesh unchanged by D-3e keeps the REAL app-capture digest of the D-3d card (rerun-card.sh f6dc9dbf, run f6dc9dbf-20260920T181942Z, ~/ob-artifacts/diamond/gully/card-f6dc9dbf/run/ours-*.json; those digests reproduce every D-3d pin, so the D-3b headless gully digests are now app-confirmed); the gully meshes D-3e changed (six sleeves, six plates) or added (two trough-sill liners) carry headless digests (plain geometry, app-exact class). Non-gully identity proven by the headless dump vs the app capture (this script refuses otherwise). Previous pin sha256 4f6de97fd5ef54b45f5ab3ea09044f3a6252a8ceb1556f343e89416b9a239a8a. Hash format: little-endian Float64 positions followed by little-endian Uint32 indices.

derivation.source: D-3d card app dumps + headless D-3e gully delta
